/// Shipping for a parcel of `weight` kilograms.
pub fn shipping(weight: u32) -> u32 {
    let base = 5;
    if weight > 10 {
        return base * 3;
    }
    base
}

pub fn untouched(a: u32) -> u32 {
    a + 1
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn light_parcel() {
        assert_eq!(shipping(1), 5);
    }

    #[test]
    fn untouched_adds_one() {
        assert_eq!(untouched(1), 2);
    }
}
